Whether you're a homeowner, you live alone, or you're looking out for parents who do, you're in the right place. channels.title: Konrad Fischer's Woodfire
channels.description:
My name is Konrad Fischer. I have heated my house with wood for forty years in the Black Forest, and my father did the same before me.

In Germany we do not treat wood heat as a hobby. Firewood is seasoned two years, not one. A chimney sweep inspects every stove by law. Nobody burns wet wood, because everyone was taught what wet wood does to a flue.

Most people I meet who burn wood are doing three or four things wrong that nobody ever corrected. Not because they are careless — because nobody told them. That is what this channel is for.

Every week: which woods to burn and which to never put in a stove, how to season firewood properly, how to run a stove so it holds heat all night, and how to keep a chimney safe.

Everything here comes from forty years of doing it, not from a manual.
